title: Sample-driven variant affinity scorer and changelog weaver
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: onboarding noise and poor release notes. Teams running model intake reported frequent manual steps to interpret variant deltas and to estimate production impact (latency/cost/compat). This PR introduces two cooperating subsystems: 1) a sample-driven Variant Affinity Scorer that calculates affinity scores per variant from sampled telemetry (latency distribution, cost estimate, error-rate signal) and compatibility fingerprints; and 2) a Changelog Weaver service that synthesizes concise release notes by grouping delta changes into human-friendly 'episodes' (impact, recommended action, example prompts). Goals: reduce manual curation work for model owners, surface low-risk downgrade/rollback candidates, and draft initial release notes for maintainers to edit.

What this PR does (high level):
- Add telemetry-based sampling pipeline and a lightweight affinity scoring model (heuristic + logistic regressor fallback) that outputs a normalized affinity score (0.0-1.0) and risk tags (latency_high, cost_increase, token_regression).
- Introduce a changelog-weaver worker that consumes variant diffs + affinity signals and produces an auto-drafted release "episode" for each high-impact delta.
- Wire the weaver into the existing onboard pipeline: new step in intake flow that emits a preview draft to the model "release_notes" field and stores a changelog fragment in the manifest bucket.
- CLI: add `rw-registry preview-changelog <model:version>` to fetch and display weaver output for review.

Design notes:
- Affinity scorer runs on a sampled subset of production telemetry to limit cost (default sample rate 0.5%). It computes feature buckets (p50/p95 latency delta vs baseline, per-token cost delta, top-5 failure mode delta) and uses a small logistic regressor trained on historic rollbacks to estimate risk. The implementation is intentionally modular so we can replace the regressor with a neural scorer later.
- Weaver groups variant diffs by affected API surfaces (generation, embeddings, rerank), tags them with affinity risk, and emits 3 short sentences: summary, impact, suggested mitigation (if any). It also attaches a single representative prompt/response pair showing the behavioral delta when available.
- Privacy: sampled telemetry is hashed and aggregated; no raw user text is retained in the scoring pipeline. See compliance notes below.

Checklist:
- [x] Affinity scoring proto + unit tests
- [x] Weaver worker + rendering templates
- [x] Integration into intake pipeline (preview path only)
- [x] CLI preview command
- [x] E2E tests for sample path and drafts generation
- [x] Documentation: short-runbook and SDK doc snippet

Related work: Linear ENG-1427 (onboard quality signals), ENG-1499 (release automation experiment), SUP-884 (customer intake pain).

review_comments:
Diego Alvarez: Nice compact design. A couple of asks: (1) please add a small counter metric for 'skipped_no_baseline' so we can measure coverage; (2) make the sample-rate configurable via env var and surface default in docs.
Maya Chen (author): Added 'skipped_no_baseline' metric and exported SAMPLE_RATE env var; updated runbook with default.
Priya Patel: The privacy note looks reasonable but please confirm no user PII is ever written to manifest bucket; add a unit test that asserts telemetry aggregator redacts text.
Maya Chen: Added redaction test and CI check that fails if raw_text appears in artifacts.
Liam O'Connor: Quick suggestion on templates: shorten suggested mitigation wording for mobile SDKs; provided copy edits inline.
Diego Alvarez: Approved after changes.
Priya Patel: Approved.
Merge approvals: 2 (Diego, Priya).

Squash message: 'sample-driven variant affinity scorer + changelog weaver: onboard draft automation and telemetry sampling (ENG-1427, ENG-1499)'. Backported migration added to manifest/migrations. Release: feature gated behind 'weaver_preview' until opt-in.
release_notes:
- Introduce a telemetry-sampled Variant Affinity Scorer to estimate risk and cost impact for new model variants.
- Add Changelog Weaver to auto-draft concise release notes and changelog fragments for model owners.
- New CLI: 'rw-registry preview-changelog' to preview auto-drafted release episodes.
- Behavior behind opt-in feature flag 'weaver_preview'.
notes_for_security_review: Sampled telemetry is hashed and aggregated; we added a failing unit test to detect accidental plaintext retention. KMS encryption is used for manifest bucket at rest. Recommend SRE run a short validation job after deployment to ensure no raw_text artifacts are present in S3 prefixes.
